data.name: Gran Hotel Azuero
data.address: P.º Enrique Geenzier, Chitré, Provincia de Herrera, Panama
data.description:
A 13-minute walk from regional exhibits at Museo de Herrera, this relaxed hotel is 2 km from the elegant, 18th-century San Juan Bautista Cathedral. It's 4 km from Chitré Alonso Valderrama Airport.
Casual rooms provide free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and safes. Family rooms with direct access to the pool sleep up to 4. Suites offer sitting areas and minifridges; some rooms and suites feature balconies with pool views. Upgraded suites add 4-poster beds, plus separate living rooms with dining areas.
Complimentary perks include parking and breakfast. There's a laid-back restaurant, a bar and a gym, plus an outdoor pool, a kids' pool and a sundeck.
